title: Game chat
infoChip: Messages disappear {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} after the game
infoDetail: Chats close when the game ends. Messages are deleted {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} later, except reported messages, which we keep for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} so we can review them.
